profile: non-commutativity: a property of composition in which the order of operations affects the result, expressed as π ∘ σ ≠ σ ∘ π. In graph neural networks, this concept appears in the context of permutation invariance and equivariance, indicating that swapping the order of permutations does not generally yield the same outcome.
